niche: a Swiss pension foundation's private-markets programme electing its 2027 standby facility for capital calls, when four funds committed in 2022 and 2023 deployed slowly through the 2023-24 deal drought and reach the end of their investment periods in the last four months of 2027 with roughly half their commitments undrawn
answer: Elect a standby facility of CHF 225 million for 2027
stakeholder_role: head of treasury and liquidity at a Swiss pension foundation, electing the standby facility that bridges the private-markets programme's 2027 capital calls

spine.entity: one line of one capital call or distribution notice received from a fund manager, or one distribution advice loaded from the custodian's feed

world.org_type: occupational pension foundation (Pensionskasse, a Stiftung) with a private-markets programme

driver: A unit's forward draw on what remains of its allotment is set by how much it must still place before a hard deadline, because every unit whose deadline has passed had placed all but a small reserve by it whatever its earlier pace; a draw rate pooled by age over units that kept to schedule gives a group that fell behind and meets its deadline inside the window the same modest share as any unit of its age, and understates the window's total.
driver_concrete: Loschwitz Equity III, Juneau Infrastructure Partners II, Rosenthal Buyout Partners II and Tessin Private Credit I deployed slowly through 2023-24 and their investment periods end between 20 September and 18 December 2027 with 45.6 to 61.8 per cent of their commitments drawn; every fund whose investment period has ended in the programme's record had drawn 92.2 to 93.3 per cent of commitment by then, slow starters included, so their 2027 calls are the balance to that share (about CHF 168 million), not the age-band call rate applied to their unfunded commitment (CHF 79.7 million).
stump: A competent solver forecasts 2027 calls fund by fund with age-band call rates on unfunded commitment estimated from the programme's record and elects a facility several tranches short; the step that lands it there is giving four funds that are far behind schedule, with investment periods ending in late 2027, the call rate of funds their age, when every fund whose investment period has ended had drawn about 92 per cent of commitment by then.
analyst_test: A strong analyst who reads every term right (calls by value date with fees and expenses, every commitment in the register, the plan-date rate, distributions not credited) and fits the field's standard pacing model, age-band call rates on unfunded commitment, still elects a facility several tranches short, because the model gives the four funds whose investment periods end in late 2027 the call rate of funds their age instead of the balance they must draw before their deadlines.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is a private-markets commitment pacing forecast, capital calls driven by each fund's undrawn commitment and by the investment period its limited partnership agreement allows for new investments, which is how a pension fund's treasury sizes liquidity for unfunded commitments; with another field's nouns there is no commitment drawn down by a manager, no investment period that closes the undrawn balance to new deals and no fee charged on commitment, so the task stops reading the same.
layer1: call and distribution notices withdrawn by the manager and reissued under a new number
multi-line notices with investment, management fee and partnership expense lines
currency codes in mixed case and descriptions with trailing spaces as keyed by clerks
distribution advices loaded by the custodian's feed from January 2026 as single lines beside the clerks' line-by-line keying of the same notices, in parallel until September
custodian credit dates a few days after the payment date stated on the notice, and credits booked the day after their value date
distributions in specie of listed shares
manager statements received months after the period end, some still outstanding
audited capital accounts at fund and year-end grain beside the line-level ledger
look-through holdings by quarter with NACE codes from the managers' reports
a reference-rate table in long form for every currency the custodian quotes, some per 100 units, without holidays
final closes still to come left blank in the register
German and English labels across the systems

lineage.fate: retired 2026-10-11: decisive stump was a hidden recycling term recovered from audited cells, data semantics under the client's 10/10 rules
lineage.driver: The forward draw on a book of open commitments is each unit's age rate applied to its size and capped at what remains undrawn, and what remains undrawn is restored by the proceeds of any holding sold within a fixed time of its purchase, up to the original size, a rule stated nowhere and recovered only because the certified year-end balances reproduce under plain size-minus-draws for every unit that had no quick sale and fail for the ones that did; the months since the last certified year-end carry a run of quick sales far larger than any closed year, so carrying the certified balances forward net of draws, or rebuilding them from draws alone, leaves the cap biting on units that in fact have room and under-sizes the forward draw.

lineage.fate: retired 2026-10-11: walk-forward selection with filed mechanics, both portal responses executed it and landed the call
lineage.driver: The forward figure is struck from whichever of several candidate pacing bases survives a walk-forward test on the closed years, with every rate re-estimated at each origin from the record before that origin and the facility sized at the plan plus the largest miss of the test; fitting once on the whole window and scoring the past with it crowns the richest base and understates the miss, so the easy validation lands two tranches short while every definition and rule in the pack is read correctly.

lineage.fate: replaced on paper at the 2026-10-12 redesign, before any portal test: the plan was the directive's filed walk-forward (rule application, the step both v2 portal responses executed), and the buffer's estimand was filed in s.5.6 ('at any point in a horizon'), a readable rung under the readability screen
lineage.driver: The facility covers a cumulative path through the year, so the buffer the validation sets is the furthest realised calls ran ahead of the forecast at any point inside a test horizon; the error table a solver builds is on horizon totals, and reading the buffer off it lands a tranche short, because calls cluster in the first half of each year while every candidate spreads them evenly, with the filed walk-forward and the filed recycling term executed correctly on both paths.
